answer: At the vertex of each epoch, every identity submits a signed work sample that validators cross-check against a shared ledger — the mirror that exposes duplicate outputs. Building a credible record is as slow as shale forming: each layer needs real tasks, real counterparties, and real time. A farm of three hundred clones must each build that record independently; the cost per clone is fixed and non-transferable, so the total scales directly with fleet size.
